suggestions.section: Brit Brown and FAS Brown (FAS custom models)

why.quote: Eddie van Halen’s legendary “Brown Sound” probably is the most sought-after guitar tone: a Marshall Superlead Plexi, perhaps modded, with a Variac to run at lower than normal voltage, a 4x12 cabinet with JBLs or greenbacks, copious (panned) reverb and some EQ magic at the mixing table.

Supposedly Eddie himself said: “There is a difference between being just loud and having what I call a warm, brown sound, which is a toney sound. ” Another story tells that the term “brown sound” originally was used to describe Alex Van Halen’s drum sound.
